texts.a_fields_0: The sails have stopped, so no flour today. Can you get them turning?
texts.a_fields_1: My window boxes are empty. They look so sad.
texts.a_fields_2: My sunflowers are tiny. Help them grow tall?
texts.a_fields_3: The sheep are all mixed up. Help me settle them?
texts.a_fields_4: Leaves have clogged the fountain. Let us clear it.
texts.a_frost_0: Frost on the inside of the windows! Help me warm up?
texts.a_frost_1: I want a snowman, but the snow will not stick!
texts.a_frost_2: My sheep are shivering. They need some cheer.
texts.a_frost_3: Winter berries grow in the snow, if you know the words.
texts.a_frost_4: The well is frozen solid. Let us thaw it out.
texts.a_glen_0: The nights are getting long, and my lamps will not light.
texts.a_glen_1: My chimney is blocked and my house is so cold.
texts.a_glen_2: The harvest fair is soon, and my pumpkins are still tiny.
texts.a_glen_3: The pigs are hungry, and the trough is empty.
texts.a_glen_4: Leaves have filled the well. Spell with me and we will clean it.
texts.a_harbor_0: Boats are coming home, and my light has gone out!
texts.a_harbor_1: Salt wind has made my house so gray and gloomy.
texts.a_harbor_2: My stall is empty and the market opens soon.
texts.a_harbor_3: Sea roses grow in the sand, but mine will not bloom.
texts.a_harbor_4: A harbor needs a fountain. Ours has been dry since the storm.
texts.a_lantern_0: Tonight is the lantern festival, and not one lantern is lit.
texts.a_lantern_1: This is the story house, but the stories have gone quiet.
texts.a_lantern_2: Moonflowers only open for well-spelled words.
texts.a_lantern_3: Everyone wants star cookies, but my oven is cold.
texts.a_lantern_4: You have helped every corner of Wordhollow. One last fountain waits.
texts.a_meadow_0: My oven went cold overnight. A few good words should warm it right up.
texts.a_meadow_1: These tulips are sleeping in. Will you help me wake them?
texts.a_meadow_2: My hens are in a flap. Spell with me and they will calm down.
texts.a_meadow_3: Our lamps will not light. Can you spell a little brightness in?
texts.a_meadow_4: The well has gone dry. Around here, words are what fill it.
texts.a_orchard_0: My shutters are stuck shut. It is so gloomy in here.
texts.a_orchard_1: The apples are still green and hard. Help them along?
texts.a_orchard_2: My goats are grumpy today. Nothing makes them smile.
texts.a_orchard_3: I have baskets but no fruit to put in them.
texts.a_orchard_4: The crank is stuck. Words make good oil around here.
texts.a_pond_0: Cobwebs everywhere! Help me sweep them out with some spelling?
texts.a_pond_1: Not one cabbage has come up. Maybe they need to hear some words.
texts.a_pond_2: The ducks have no water to paddle in. Can you help?
texts.a_pond_3: Market day, and my cart is bare. Spell me some loaves?
texts.a_pond_4: This fountain has been quiet for years. Let us wake it up.
texts.r_fields: Windmill Fields. In a blend, you hear every sound. Frog: [[f|f]], [[ɹ|r]], [[ɑ|ah]], [[ɡ|g]]. Stretch the word out slowly.
texts.r_frost: Frostfen. When r follows a vowel, it is bossy and changes the sound. A R says [[ɑɹ|ar]]. O R says [[ɔɹ|or]]. E R, I R and U R all say [[ɝ|er]].
texts.r_glen: Pumpkin Glen. Silent e makes the vowel say its name. Kit becomes kite. Hop becomes hope. You cannot hear the e, but you have to write it.
texts.r_harbor: Saltwind Harbor. Vowel teams are two letters that make one long sound. Rain and play both say [[eɪ|ay]]: A I goes in the middle, A Y goes at the end.
texts.r_lantern: Lantern Heights. Long words are made of parts. Jumping is jump, plus ing. Sunset is sun, plus set. And the ending E D can sound three ways, but it is always spelled E D.
texts.r_meadow: Meadow Hollow. Short a says [[æ|a]], as in apple. Short i says [[ɪ|ih]], as in itch. Tap each sound, then spell it.
texts.r_orchard: Orchard Rise. Some letter pairs make one sound. S H says [[ʃ|sh]]. C H says [[tʃ|ch]]. T H says [[θ|th]]. And after a short vowel, the [[k|k]] sound at the end is spelled C K.
texts.r_pond: Willow Pond. Short o says [[ɑ|ah]], as in octopus. Short u says [[ʌ|uh]], as in up. Short e says [[ɛ|eh]], as in egg.
texts.s_bag: Put the apple in the bag.
texts.s_because: I smiled because I was happy.
texts.s_bike: I ride my bike to school.
texts.s_boat: The boat floats on the sea.
texts.s_bug: A bug is on the leaf.
texts.s_cake: We had cake for my birthday.
texts.s_cat: The cat naps in the sun.
texts.s_chin: He has jam on his chin.
texts.s_chip: My cup has a chip in it.
texts.s_duck: The duck swims in the pond.
texts.s_feet: My feet are wet from the waves.
texts.s_fern: A fern grows in the shade.
texts.s_fishing: We went fishing on the lake.
texts.s_flag: The flag waves in the wind.
texts.s_fox: The fox ran into the woods.
texts.s_frog: The frog hops into the pond.
texts.s_girl: The girl ran up the hill.
texts.s_helped: She helped me carry the bag.
texts.s_hen: The hen sits on her eggs.
texts.s_jam: I like jam on my toast.
texts.s_jump: Can you jump over the log?
texts.s_jumping: We are jumping in the leaves.
texts.s_kite: My kite flew over the trees.
texts.s_leaf: A leaf fell from the tree.
texts.s_lid: Put the lid on the pot.
texts.s_log: A frog sat on a log.
texts.s_mud: My boots are in the mud.
texts.s_neck: The giraffe has a long neck.
texts.s_nest: The bird sits on her nest.
texts.s_net: She caught a fish in her net.
texts.s_of: I ate a bowl of soup.
texts.s_pig: The pig rolls in the mud.
texts.s_rain: The rain taps on the roof.
texts.s_rainbow: A rainbow is in the sky.
texts.s_ran: The dog ran to the gate.
texts.s_road: The road goes to the sea.
texts.s_seed: Plant the seed in the dirt.
texts.s_shark: The shark swims in the sea.
texts.s_ship: The ship sails on the sea.
texts.s_sled: We ride the sled down the hill.
texts.s_snow: The snow is cold and white.
texts.s_sunset: The sunset was pink and gold.
texts.s_tail: The cat has a long tail.
texts.s_tree: A bird sits in the tree.
texts.s_van: The van is big and blue.
texts.s_whip: Whip the cream until it is fluffy.
texts.s_win: I hope we win the game.
texts.t_fields_0: Round and round! Take a sack of flour.
texts.t_fields_1: Much better. Try my plum jam!
texts.t_fields_2: Taller than me! Here is one for you.
texts.t_fields_3: All calm. Have some of their wool.
texts.t_fields_4: Clear as glass. Take a wishing stone.
texts.t_frost_0: Warm as toast. Take my spare mittens.
texts.t_frost_1: He is perfect! Have a snowflake charm.
texts.t_frost_2: Cozy and fluffy. Take a ball of wool.
texts.t_frost_4: Water again! Have a hot cocoa.
texts.t_glen_0: Such a warm glow. Take a candle home.
texts.t_glen_1: Toasty! I knitted this scarf by the fire.
texts.t_glen_3: Happy snorts all round. Have a slice of pie.
texts.t_glen_4: Sparkling. You should keep the lucky penny I found.
texts.t_harbor_0: They will find their way now. Take this sea glass.
texts.t_harbor_1: Fresh as a sea breeze! Take a fish for supper.
texts.t_harbor_2: Busiest stall on the dock! Have a salt biscuit.
texts.t_harbor_3: Pink as a sunrise! One is for you.
texts.t_harbor_4: Ha! Splendid. A gold coin, for luck at sea.
texts.t_lantern_0: Glowing all the way up the hill! Keep this one.
texts.t_lantern_1: I can hear them again! Take a storybook.
texts.t_lantern_2: Look how they shine. Take one to light your way.
texts.t_lantern_3: Still warm! Have the biggest one.
texts.t_lantern_4: Wordhollow is whole again, thanks to you. This golden star is yours.
texts.t_meadow_0: Smell that bread! Take a warm roll for the road.
texts.t_meadow_1: Look at them stretch! Here, pick one.
texts.t_meadow_2: Happy hens lay good eggs. This one is for you.
texts.t_meadow_3: So cozy now! You can have my spare ribbon.
texts.t_meadow_4: Fresh and cold again. Take a cup with you.
texts.t_orchard_0: Sunshine at last! I knitted you a scarf.
texts.t_orchard_1: Red and crisp! Pick the best one.
texts.t_orchard_2: Hopping about again! Take some fresh milk.
texts.t_orchard_3: What a stand! Cherries for you.
texts.t_orchard_4: Turns like new. I found this old key in the bucket.
texts.t_pond_0: Spotless! Please take a jar of honey.
texts.t_pond_1: Big as my head! Take the first leaf.
texts.t_pond_2: Splashing again! One of them left you a feather.
texts.t_pond_3: Full to the top. Have a berry pie.
texts.t_pond_4: Listen to it sing! Here is a coin to toss in.
texts.ui_again: Almost. Listen again, and fix the sounds that are marked.
texts.ui_cover: Now it is hidden. Can you spell it from memory?
texts.ui_heart: This is a heart word. Part of it does not follow the rules, so we learn that part by heart. Look closely.
texts.ui_study: Here is how it is spelled. Look closely, and say each sound as you point.
texts.ui_welcome: Welcome to Wordhollow. Here, well spelled words bring things to life. Walk up to anyone who needs help.
